responsibility: Defines the low-level binary-search-tree container used by gm2 to map interned names to symbol numbers and to traverse scoped name tables. It exports the opaque `SymbolTree` type, the null-symbol constant, insertion, lookup, deletion, emptiness and containment tests, node counting, and whole-tree traversal callbacks, providing the primitive name-to-symbol storage layer on which `SymbolTable` builds scope-sensitive identifier lookup.
same_name_distinction: This `.def` file is the abstract interface for the SymbolKey tree container, exposing the opaque `SymbolTree` type, callback signatures, null key, and tree operations, whereas `SymbolKey.mod` contains the concrete node structure and traversal/deletion algorithms.
